1170-2733-5334-5954-8345.description:
Cast Shimmering Wings by paying {U}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Warp Speed.
Resolve the Shimmering Wings spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

862-5006-6495-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Crimson Kobolds is starting in your graveyard.
862-5006-6495-8170.description:
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Crimson Kobolds spell. Then, activate Evereth by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat.
862-5006-6495-8170.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

3499-4770-6006-6090.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2023-3755-4518-7730.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

265-2073-6798--90.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning the artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the artifact.
Sly Requisitioner triggers, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, surveiling 1.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the Servo.
When the Servo dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, surveiling 1.
Repeat.
265-2073-6798--90.notes: If the artifact can sacrifice itself, you can do so in lieu of sacrificing the artifact to Umbral Collar Zealot. Also, if the artifact can tap to produce mana (like Sol Ring) or other products, you can do that as well.

1981-2415-6634-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Al Bhed Salvagers and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

3129-4365-6763-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

301-2813-4381.easyPrerequisites: There's an artifact on the battlefield.
301-2813-4381.description:
Activate Goblin Trashmaster by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Grumgully.
Resolve the Goblin Trashmaster ability.
Repeat.

2232-7827-7829-7837.easyPrerequisites: One of the Dwarves with mana value 1 must be on your hand, with the other on the battlefield.
2232-7827-7829-7837.description:
Cast the Dwarf with mana value 1 that's in your hand by paying its mana cost.
When the Dwarf enters, Cloudstone Curio and Thorin trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the other Dwarf with mana value 1 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thorin trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R/W}.
Repeat.

129-1409-3755-7296.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

uses.n: Tetzin, Gnome Champion // The Golden-Gear Colossus

1379-2388-6587-7715.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Golden-Gear Colossus.
1379-2388-6587-7715.description:
Declare The Golden-Gear Colossus as an attacker. It triggers, creating two 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens and transforming Ultimecia, Time Sorceress into Ultimecia, Omnipotent.
Ultimecia, Omnipotent triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, The Mighty Thor triggers, blinking Ultimecia, Omnipotent. It'll enter the battlefield as Ultimecia, Time Sorceress.
When Ultimecia, Time Sorceress enters, it triggers, causing you to surveil 2.
Repeat each turn.

1368-5295-6321-6723.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-5295-6321-6723.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

2034-5003-7484.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Pestbrood Sloth, adding {C}{C}.
When Pestbrood Sloth dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger,
Resolve the Pestbrood Sloth trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Pestbrood Sloth from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Tui and La, Moon and Ocean

4222-5268-7065.description:
Activate Tui and La by tapping it, adding {U}.
Tui and La's first ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Tui and La.
Tui and La's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-4742-6642.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4742-6642.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, SOLDIER Military Program triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-4742-6642.notes: If you control a commander, you can choose both of SOLDIER Military Program's modes.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-3968-6791.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-3968-6791.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Grave Titan as attackers.
Grave Titan triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

6662-6798-7084.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Chocobo Racetrack triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 5 or greater

3750-6102-7016.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Firebending Student.
3750-6102-7016.description:
Declare Firebending Student as an attacker, triggering its ability, adding an amount of {R} equal to its power.
Move to your postcombat main phase. You will not lose the mana due to Ashling.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

2060-2576-2919-4222.easyPrerequisites:
Temple Elder does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Temple Elder.
2060-2576-2919-4222.description:
Activate Temple Elder by tapping it, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's ability by paying {U}, untapping Temple Elder.
Repeat.

1580-2060-2438-6701.description:
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.
1580-2060-2438-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.

632-1115-2034-3621-5129.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Cast Scarecrone by paying {3}.
When Scarecrone enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Scarecrone.
Activate the nontoken Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken Scarecrone, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Mirrorworks trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing both Su-Chi Cave Guards, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guards die, they trigger, adding 16 {C}.
Activate the token Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Scarecrone from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
632-1115-2034-3621-5129.notes: If you have mana available, you can instead sacrifice the Scarecrones to their first abilities.

292-4968-5902.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Deathbringer Thoctar.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Deathbringer Thoctar.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-4968-5902.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.

2946-4871-5231.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-4871-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Cult Conscript, adding {R}.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

2825-5892.easyPrerequisites: Rustler Rampage exiled by Elite Arcanist.
2825-5892.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
2825-5892.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Elite Arcanist by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Rustler Rampage and casting the copy without paying its mana cost, and choosing to pay an additional {1} to select its first mode.
Resolve the copy of Rustler Rampage, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

1789-4452-5649-5686.notablePrerequisites: Rukarumel on the battlefield with "Dragon" chosen.
1789-4452-5649-5686.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

56-3220-4054-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-3220-4054-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Golgari Germination triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Primeval Bounty triggers, creating a 3/3 Beast creature token.
Repeat.
56-3220-4054-5256.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

565-3803-4423-6204-6205.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three Islands.
You have solved Case of the Ransacked Lab.
565-3803-4423-6204-6205.description:
Cast Dream's Grip by paying {U}, targeting Mystic Sanctuary.
Orvar and Case of the Ransacked Lab trigger.
Resolve the Orvar trigger, creating a token copy of Mystic Sanctuary.
When the Mystic Sanctuary token enters the battlefield untapped, it triggers, putting Aquitect's Will from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Case of the Ransacked Lab trigger, drawing Aquitect's Will from the top of your library.
Resolve Dream's Grip, untapping Mystic Sanctuary.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and the Mystic Sanctuary token by tapping them, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Aquitect's Will by paying {U}, targeting Mystic Sanctuary.
Orvar and Case of the Ransacked Lab trigger.
Resolve the Orvar trigger, creating a token copy of Mystic Sanctuary.
When the Mystic Sanctuary token enters the battlefield untapped, it triggers, putting Dream's Grip from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Case of the Ransacked Lab trigger, drawing Dream's Grip from the top of your library.
Resolve Aquitect's Will, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

511-817-2557-3334-4050.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

1558-5325.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five Knights that do not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1558-5325.description:
Deal combat damage using at least five Knights.
Exsanguinator Cavalry triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each attacking Knight and creating that many Blood artifact tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Bloods, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat.

225-1021-2404-4693.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least three creatures.
225-1021-2404-4693.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Activate Drownyard Temple by paying {3}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Drownyard Temple enters the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat.
If you control four or more creatures, this combo nets infinite mana.

1329-2829-3363.easyPrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-2829-3363.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing The One Ring, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Ravager
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast The One Ring from your graveyard this turn.
Cast The One Ring by paying {4}.
The One Ring triggers, giving you protection from everything until your next turn.
Repeat during each of your turns.

2445-2744-3693-3828.notablePrerequisites:
Druid's Call attached to Walking Ballista.
Walking Ballista has at least three +1/+1 counters.
2445-2744-3693-3828.description:
Activate Walking Ballista's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Druid's Call triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
The Squirrel enters the battlefield, triggering Cathars' Crusade, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Repeat.

656-678-4145.description:
Cast Ugin's Conjurant by paying 0.
Ugin's Conjurant dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Enduring Renewal and Millicent triggers.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Ugin's Conjurant from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Millicent's trigger, creating a 1/1 Spirit token.
Repeat.

215-3291-5295.notablePrerequisites:
Karametra's Acolyte does not have summoning sickness.
Your devotion to green is at least seven.
215-3291-5295.description:
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by tapping it, adding at least seven {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Karametra's Acolyte from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Karametra's Acolyte by paying {3}{G}.
Repeat.

2493-3557-4872.notablePrerequisites:
Brago does not have summoning sickness.
Brago can not be blocked.
2493-3557-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, getting an extra turn after this one.
Move to your combat phase.
Deal combat damage with Brago, blinking Archaeomancer.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.
